UserGuidance.title: User Guidance
UserGuidance.description: Master GlossaryAI with our step-by-step guides for translation, history tracking, and glossary management.
UserGuidance.demoVideoDescription: In this video, we will walk you through the core features of GlossaryAI, from uploading your first document to managing your glossaries.
UserGuidance.demoVideoNoteText: Please turn on Subtitles/CC in the video player to see the detailed guidance for each step!
UserGuidance.step1Description: Upload your documents and select the source and target languages for translation.
UserGuidance.step2Description: Select any relevant glossaries to ensure accurate terminology translation.
UserGuidance.step3Description: Check your configuration to make sure everything is set up correctly before proceeding.
UserGuidance.step4Description: Begin the translation process and download the files once completed.
UserGuidance.historySubtitle: Track and manage your past jobs
UserGuidance.viewPastJobsDescription: Access a complete list of your previous translations. Each entry includes details like the date, file type, source and target languages, and the final status of the translation.
UserGuidance.smartSearchDescription: Quickly find specific translations by searching for file names or unique job IDs. This is helpful when you need to locate a specific document from weeks ago.
UserGuidance.redownloadDescription: Need a file again? You can easily download your original uploaded documents or the resulting translated files at any time from your history records.
UserGuidance.createImportDescription: Start by creating a new glossary to define your preferred terminology. You can build it term-by-term or import an existing text file (.txt) to populate it instantly.
UserGuidance.editManageDescription: Keep your glossaries up to date. You can edit definitions, add new terms as your project evolves, or delete glossaries that are no longer needed.
